versions.content: If the function Spi_SetAsyncMode is called while the SPI Handler/Driver status is SPI_BUSY and an asynchronous transmission is in progress, the SPI Handler/Driver shall not change the AsyncModeType and keep the mode type as it is. The function shall return the value E_NOT_OK.
